purpose: G2: a measurable operating point at EXACTLY the BIKE Level-1 code parameters (r,d)=(12323,71); only the error weight t is raised from the production 134 into the measurable band. Keys are the archived L1 pool.
calibration_rule: C0 only, 6 keys x 200 errors at t in [150, 160, 170, 180]; choose the t whose C0 DFR lands in [1e-4,1e-2], closest to 1e-3; if none qualifies, report the closest and DO NOT extend the scan beyond the candidate list without a new amendment.

main_run.features: per-instance first-round features logged for the P1' surrogate cross-code validation

analysis: RR + key-clustered CI95 per arm vs C0; mean iters; surrogate prediction in exp_surrogate_model phase S5.

amendments.written_before: seeing the calibration output (the calibration run was in flight)
amendments.reason: 6 keys x 200 errors = 1200 trials per candidate t gives only ~1.2 expected failures at DFR=1e-3, so a zero count is uninformative and the frozen "closest to 1e-3" rule could pick a t whose true DFR is far from the band.
rule: If the first calibration pass yields >0 failures at any candidate t, the frozen rule is applied unchanged.

If EVERY candidate t yields 0 failures, extend each candidate to 8 keys x 1000 errors (8000 trials) in ONE additional pass and apply the same "closest to 1e-3, in band [1e-4,1e-2]" rule to the extended counts.

If after the extension every candidate still yields 0 failures, report the P1PP point as NOT REACHED (no measurable operating point in the swept t range) and do not extend the scan further without a new amendment.
amendments.note: This is a sample-size escalation with a fixed decision rule, not a significance-based stopping rule; it does not peek at the P1PP main outcome.
amendments.evidence_context: The archived L1 static-carrier runs recorded 0 failures in 8000 trials at t=134, and the C reference 0 in 9e6, so t=134 is far below the measurable band for this code.

amendments.written_before: the extension scan and the P1PP main run
amendments.observed_in_first_pass: t=150/160/170 each gave C0 0/1200 (95% upper bound 2.5e-3); the frozen candidate list misses the band entirely
amendments.decision: The first pass shows the (12323,71) code is far above the production error weight before its DFR enters the measurable band, so the candidate range is extended ONCE to t in {180, 195, 210, 230}, 6 keys x 300 errors per point, same rule (in band [1e-4,1e-2], closest to 1e-3).
amendments.cap: If no t in the extended range lands in band, P1PP is reported as NOT REACHED and no further extension is made; the production anchor then rests on the L1a mechanism statistics and on the surrogate prediction, both labelled as such.
amendments.disclosure: This is a calibration-range extension, disclosed with the first-pass result, in the same spirit as the archived Q1-Q4 sweep that reported its own band misses. The main-run decision rule is unchanged.

amendments.written_before: the bisection points t=175 (and, if needed, one further split)
amendments.rule_defect: The frozen "closest to 1e-3" comparison uses the raw observed DFR, so zero-failure candidates evaluate to |0 - 1e-3| = 1e-3 and appear closer to the target than t=180 (|0.135-0.001|); executed literally it selects t=150, the lowest-pressure point. That is an artefact of the comparison, not a calibration result, and is disclosed rather than followed.
amendments.replacement_rule: Because DFR is monotone in t and the scan brackets the target band: DFR(170) <= 2.5e-3 (below or inside) and DFR(180) = 1.35e-1 (above), the target band [1e-4,1e-2] lies in t in (170,180). Bisect the bracket: measure t=175; if its DFR is in band, it is the operating point; otherwise bisect once more within the narrowed integer bracket; then stop and report where the band was found (or that it was not found within the bracket).
amendments.cap: At most two bisection measurements; the bisection can only narrow a bracket that was already established without reference to the P1PP main outcome.
amendments.cost: each bisection point is 6 keys x 300 errors (~1-2 min), C0 only

amendments.correction: Amendments 1-3 and bisect_p1pp.py's docstring state the calibration sample as 6 keys x 300 errors; the executed sample was 6 x 200 = 1200 trials per point (L1S_E_CAL=200; p1pp_calibration.json's dfr denominators confirm). The rule and the chosen t*=172 are unaffected.
amendments.also: bisect_p1pp.py's third candidate (t=178) was unreachable because of a POINTS[:2] slice; fixed in the script (it was never needed).
